title: Clay Relationship Weekly Days Since Touch Trend
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=clay:relationship days_since_touch=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_since_touch) as avg_duration, max(days_since_touch) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days since touch for Clay relationship events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_since_touch on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days since touch with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether Clay relationship tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
